name: Youth UpRising Summer Jobs and Job Readiness
what_you_do: You can get job readiness training. You can also get paid summer jobs or internships in East Oakland. Career and education services are open all year.
who_can_apply: East Oakland youth. The City of Oakland list shows YU summer jobs for ages 14 to 21. YU serves ages 13 to 24 overall.
pay_detail: Paid (100 hours of fully paid work per the City list); rate not posted
duration: About 100 hours over 4 to 6 weeks (City list)
deadline_text: No dates posted on the site. Contact YU in spring for the next summer.
how_to_apply: Call 510-777-9909 or visit 8711 MacArthur Blvd, Oakland. The site gives no online form.
notes: YU's own site has no summer job details, so the ages and hours come from the City of Oakland's 2026 list. Also a referral partner for EBMUD's high school internship.
